items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: First group that I formed was Al Miller. With Al Miller. Yeah. Robert Parker.

ctx.x: Yeah, this is just amateur stuff.

Yeah. To make a quarter, you know. First group that I formed was Al Miller. With Al Miller. Yeah. Robert Parker. One size. One that recorded Balfootin'. Yeah. And myself. It was hard to go way back. I had another kid with me with a- Swish? No, this was a different thing. This was the very first group that I formed. And I came to, I can't think of his name, but he was a little, he certainly looked like a little Hungarian boy. He wasn't from here, you know. What about, wouldn't Walter Nelson with you?

items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: Yeah, I had little Robert Parker. The one that was doing bad for the 90s. They were mostly kids, but I was training them at that time.

ctx.x: Yeah, he'd be... Not too long ago, he played harmonica with his guitar's pop. Yeah, yeah. We never met him though. No, I never had met him. Never had met him. When were you born, Roy? I was born in 1918. 1918? December 19th. December 19th? And who... Can you remember who your side men were on your session with the bald head?
Bald head? Yeah, I had little Robert Parker. The one that was doing bad for the 90s. They were mostly kids, but I was training them at that time.
Yeah. And I... He playing guitar? No, he was playing sax. Playing saxophone? Yeah.
